Package it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model

Class Administrator

java.lang.Object
it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model.Person
it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model.Member
it.unipr.sportclubmanager.model.Administrator
public class Administrator extends Member
The Administrator class represents an administrator of the sports club. An administrator extends Member, since an administrator can also perform all the operations available to a member (enrolling in and cancelling enrollment from activities). In addition, an administrator can add, remove and update people and activities within the club.
